items.action_detail: Exploitation is plausible and impact is high

items.action_detail: Exploitation is plausible and impact is high

items.why_it_matters: JoomGallery administrators must update their extensions immediately to prevent stored XSS and unauthorized object access.

items.title: PoC released: CVE-2026-10053
items.description: Reproducible lab for CVE-2026-10053 (GitLab npm package-registry path traversal -> arbitrary file write as git). Vulnerable 19.2.1 vs patched 19.2.2, deterministic oracle.
items.action_detail: Exploitation is plausible and impact is high
items.ai_summary: CVE-2026-10053 is a path traversal vulnerability in the npm package-registry component of GitLab version 19.2.1. It allows an attacker to achieve arbitrary file write execution under the context of the git user. A reproducible lab and proof-of-concept are now available, demonstrating a deterministic exploit path. Administrators must immediately upgrade GitLab to version 19.2.2 or later to mitigate the risk.
items.why_it_matters: GitLab administrators should update to version 19.2.2 immediately to prevent arbitrary file write exploitation.
